cases.setup: The fast synthesis packet omits keyboard access and destructive-action confirmation because those rules are not among the top visual/style matches.
cases.pressure: The agent wants a short answer and argues deeper skills can run only if a problem appears later.
must_find: hard obligations survive compression regardless of decision budget
fast path may compress explanation but cannot drop semantic/safety/accessibility gates
cases.falsifier: If the omitted obligation is proven inapplicable by the task contract, it need not appear.
cases.recovery: Restore hard obligation IDs and acceptance hooks, then regenerate the packet with optional recommendations pruned instead.

cases.setup: An agent uses cached llms.txt/MCP output from a newer library release while the project is pinned to an older major version.
cases.pressure: The live docs are easier to query and contain better examples.
must_find: live-source hydration must respect project version identity
adapter context cannot silently overwrite pinned implementation reality
cases.falsifier: If the project is explicitly being upgraded and migration requirements are included, newer docs may become the target authority.
cases.recovery: Hydrate docs/source for the pinned version or make upgrade a first-class decision and verify migration.

cases.setup: A product needs a platform-specific convention that the authority resolver cannot currently verify, so the packet inserts the model default to avoid blocking.
cases.pressure: The user asked for speed and the missing detail seems minor.
must_find: unresolved authority must remain a blocker rather than become a guessed default
packet status should become NEEDS_RESEARCH for material unresolved dimensions
cases.falsifier: If the dimension is low-impact and explicitly inside the ambiguity budget, the execution brief may permit local choice.
cases.recovery: Mark the unresolved dimension, fetch current source evidence, and recompile only that decision.

cases.setup: An MCP design-system server is queried for hundreds of components and all returned docs are injected into the agent context.
cases.pressure: More current context seems safer than potentially omitting a useful component.
must_find: agent context budget should hydrate only the unresolved decision
context volume can dilute constraints and is not research depth
cases.falsifier: A repository-wide migration task may justify broader context if chunked by decision and verified.
cases.recovery: Reframe the decision question, retrieve only relevant API/guidance slices, and preserve pointers for later re-expansion.

cases.setup: A recommendation engine chooses a font/style/palette bundle that conflicts with explicit user language because its product-category score is higher.
cases.pressure: The database is broad and optimized for immediate answerability.
must_find: retrieval recommendation cannot outrank explicit product/experiential constraints
style/palette records are exploratory priors with transfer boundaries
cases.falsifier: If the user leaves the aesthetic axis open and the recommendation survives subject-specific critique, it may be adopted.
cases.recovery: Restore the brief as hard input, use database results for alternatives only, and recompile with local validation.

cases.setup: A coding agent receives exact colors/components/layout but no provenance, contraindication, owner or re-expansion handle.
cases.pressure: The brief is extremely short and easy to follow.
must_find: compression became lossy because decisions cannot be challenged or updated
rationale/provenance handles are required for material choices
cases.falsifier: Pure mechanical tasks with no material design choice may need only direct implementation instructions.
cases.recovery: Restore compact decision IDs, source handles, contraindications, acceptance hooks and re-expansion triggers.

cases.setup: The fast packet selects one all-purpose UI library to own semantics, charts, motion, visual identity and data state because it minimizes dependencies.
cases.pressure: A single dependency simplifies setup and documentation.
must_find: one library cannot inherit authority across unrelated layers by convenience
implementation authority must be split by proven mechanism and product-state ownership
cases.falsifier: A vertically integrated platform may legitimately own multiple layers when its contracts and target context prove that scope.
cases.recovery: Partition layers, retain the library only where it has authority, and use local/specialist owners elsewhere.

cases.setup: The agent generates an exceptional landing/workspace design from a concrete packet and stops immediately after build/tests without inspecting a render.
cases.pressure: The decisions were source-bound and all code gates are green.
must_find: high-ambition fast path still requires rendered perception
concrete planning cannot prove that implementation preserved hierarchy/type/signature/material quality
cases.falsifier: A non-visual backend-only task would not trigger perceptual evidence.
cases.recovery: Capture material states/viewports, critique the actual render, fix observed defects, and only then complete.
